reason: The specs, UL listing and free returns are what I'd want, but I've never heard of this store and it has almost no reviews. I'm not putting a $360 fixture on my kitchen schedule with the electrician back in three weeks and delivery quoted at 2 to 3 weeks.
objection: A brand-new store with hardly any verified reviews, and a 2 to 3 week delivery window that could land after my electrician is already here. If it slips, my kitchen stalls and a 10% refund doesn't fix that.
would_change_my_mind: A firm ship-by date guaranteed to arrive before the electrician visit, plus a free sample or swatch of the paper shade, or a meaningful number of verified reviews with photos of installed fixtures.
